test_admin_can_access_licenses.title: Verify the admin's sidebar offers Licenses under Admin and it opens the licence page

steps.expected: A Licenses entry is shown, linking to the licence route.
The page shows the Total Licenses summary with a whole number and the two licence tabs.

test_license_page_no_duplicate_records.title: Verify the Licenses page does not render duplicate records

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read every row of the Available Licenses table.
Compare the rows with each other, whole row against whole row.
steps.expected: No two rows are identical in every column.

test_consistent_layout_across_tabs.title: Verify the summary, the search box and the Download control are the same on both tabs

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the summary numbers, the search box and the Download icon.
steps.expected: All three are present on the Available Licenses tab.
The summary reads the same numbers, the search box and the Download icon are still there, and Assigned Licenses is the selected tab.

test_confirmation_dialogs_have_clear_mes.title: Verify the Suspend confirmation names the action and offers Cancel (device-list tripwire)

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses > Assigned Licenses, expand the first site and click a feature licence.
steps.expected: The device list opens under a breadcrumb.

steps.action: Open the first device's three-dot menu and choose Suspend.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog whose text mentions the suspension and the device, with a Cancel button.

test_tooltip_text_for_icons.title: Verify the licence page's icons carry a name: the Download icon's alt and the expand arrow's test id

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read the Download icon.
Click Assigned Licenses and read the expand arrow on a site row.
